description: Draw a chemical structure or reaction as a publication-style figure (ChemDraw-like skeletal formula) with the Lone Pair editor's renderer. Give SMILES, reaction SMILES, InChI, a molfile, a ChemDraw file, or a compound name with name=true. Refused, with the reason, instead of drawn wrongly: SMILES that cannot be read, aromatic rings that cannot alternate single and double bonds, and atoms with too many bonds (unless `as_written`). The result carries `drawing` (Lone Pair JSON to pass to edit_drawing or back in as `input`) and `notes` (anything changed on reading or lost in the format). The SVG and PNG hold the drawing inside them, so they reopen for editing at lonepair.app.

as_written.description: Draw atoms that have too many bonds instead of refusing the structure. Default false.

dpi.description: PNG resolution, 300 by default; 600 for print.

format.description: png (default; returned as an image), svg (returned as text), pdf or eps (returned as base64 in `data_base64`).

input.description: The structure as text: SMILES, reaction SMILES (reactants>agents>products), InChI, a molfile, RXN, SD file, CDXML, CML or Marvin text, or a Lone Pair drawing (the JSON from an earlier result, or the SVG text of an earlier figure).

name.description: Set to true when `input` is a compound name (e.g. "aspirin") rather than a structure. The name is sent to PubChem to find the structure; this is the only network call the server makes. Default false.

opaque.description: White background instead of transparent (SVG, PNG). Default false.

style.description: Journal style. acs = ACS Document 1996 (default), rsc = RSC, nature = Nature Reviews, slides = heavier lines for slides.

name: draw
title: Draw a structure
